environment: isolated local app with real Auth/PostgREST and synthetic accounts; deterministic provider fixture via Node preload
checks: Default login opens separate customer-profile private chat; useful typed response without sources at 1440px
Brief prefill contains only user message; required fields, explicit review/consent/save; truthful private save
Describe/review/create provisions a distinct persisted agent with saved ID/name/settings URL and a working private test at 768px
Synthetic sample inspect/editor does not create source; explicit source add remains private; cited answer/history refresh/full-turn follow-up
Exact stored title/details reviewed; approval HTTP body decision-only; approved state explicitly internal
Source delete refreshes/redacts cached conversation; API history removes original factual parts/citations
Arabic 390px RTL/no overflow and explicit keep/confirm conversation deletion
Candidate homepage at 390/768/1440 captured without horizontal overflow; baseline comparison owned by lead
limitations: Comprehension tool is supporting text review, not a consenting-reader usability test.
Home screenshots require comparison with lead baseline; capture alone is not parity.

Provider output is deterministic fixture data; this gate verifies UI/storage/authorization contracts, not live model reasoning or semantic quality. Live adapter/schema/model checks are a separate Vercel gate.

executionSegments.explanation: First two journey groups passed before harness-only select-label fix. Remaining groups resumed at builder and passed; no product source change.
